The GEMM streams a 28672×4096 BF16 weight matrix, which is about 235 MB. With M=1 it does very little compute per byte, so it is bound by HBM bandwidth. At roughly 7 TB/s of achievable bandwidth that is about 34 µs. The simulator gives about 39 µs. A real cuBLAS GEMV-like kernel usually reaches about 85–90% of peak bandwidth, which is about 36–40 µs. Inside a CUDA graph there is no launch overhead on top of that. I'll estimate 38 µs.
